name: enriched_orders
viewQuery:
SELECT
users.id AS userID,
users.name AS userName,
users.companyName AS companyName,
orders.id,
orders.company,
orders.items,
orders.paid,
orders.status,
orders.extras,
orders.extraCost,
orders.cost,
orders.euroCost,
orders.extraEuroCost,
orders.created,
orders.updated,
orders."transaction"
FROM orders
INNER JOIN users
ON users.id = orders.company

name: public_accounts
viewQuery:
SELECT 
  "accounts"."id",
  "users"."id" AS "user",
  "users"."name",
  "users"."companyName",
  "users"."isCompany"
FROM "accounts"
INNER JOIN "users" ON "accounts"."user" = "users"."id"
WHERE "users"."_hidden" = false;

name: public_transactions
viewQuery:
SELECT 
t.id,
t.sender, 
t.receiver, 
t.amount, 
t.received, 
t.system, 
t.description, 
t.signature, 
t.status, 
t.created,
su.name AS sender_name,
ru.name AS receiver_name,
su.isCompany AS sender_is_company,
ru.isCompany AS receiver_is_company,
su.companyName AS sender_company_name,
ru.companyName AS receiver_company_name,
su.id AS sender_id,
ru.id AS receiver_id
FROM transactions t
JOIN accounts sa ON t.sender = sa.id
JOIN users su ON sa.user = su.id
JOIN accounts ra ON t.receiver = ra.id
JOIN users ru ON ra.user = ru.id;

name: public_users
viewQuery: SELECT id, name, companyName, isCompany FROM users WHERE _hidden = FALSE;

name: transaction_statistics
viewQuery:
SELECT
    stats.id,
    stats.created,
    stats.sender_account_id,
    stats.receiver_account_id,
    stats.sender_user_id,
    stats.receiver_user_id,
    stats.sender_name,
    stats.receiver_name,
    stats.sender_is_company,
    stats.receiver_is_company,
    stats.flow_type,
    stats.amount,
    stats.received,
    stats.difference,
    stats.status,
    stats.system,
    stats.is_system,
    stats.is_self_transfer
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.id as id,
        t.created as created,

        t.sender as sender_account_id,
        t.receiver as receiver_account_id,

        sa.user as sender_user_id,
        ra.user as receiver_user_id,

        COALESCE(su.name, 'Unbekannt') as sender_name,
        COALESCE(ru.name, 'Unbekannt') as receiver_name,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(su."isCompany", 0) = 1 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as sender_is_company,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(ru."isCompany", 0) = 1 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as receiver_is_company,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(su."isCompany", 0) = 1
             AND COALESCE(ru."isCompany", 0) = 1
                THEN 'business_to_business'

            WHEN COALESCE(su."isCompany", 0) = 1
             AND COALESCE(ru."isCompany", 0) = 0
                THEN 'business_to_personal'

            WHEN COALESCE(su."isCompany", 0) = 0
             AND COALESCE(ru."isCompany", 0) = 1
                THEN 'personal_to_business'

            ELSE 'personal_to_personal'
        END as flow_type,

        CAST(COALESCE(t.amount, 0) AS REAL) as amount,
        CAST(COALESCE(t.received, 0) AS REAL) as received,

        CAST(
            COALESCE(t.amount, 0) -
            COALESCE(t.received, 0)
            AS REAL
        ) as difference,

        COALESCE(t.status, 'pending') as status,
        COALESCE(t."system", '') as system,

        CASE
            WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(t."system", '')) <> '' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_system,

        CASE
            WHEN sa.user = ra.user THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_self_transfer

    FROM transactions t

    INNER JOIN accounts sa
        ON sa.id = t.sender

    INNER JOIN users su
        ON su.id = sa.user

    INNER JOIN accounts ra
        ON ra.id = t.receiver

    INNER JOIN users ru
        ON ru.id = ra.user
) stats

name: warehouse_user_data
viewQuery:
SELECT
users.id AS id,
user_data.user,
users.companyName,
users.name,
user_data.euroSpent,
user_data.euroAvailable
FROM user_data
INNER JOIN users 
ON users.id = user_data.user
WHERE users.isCompany = true;
